Spartan Logistics has expanded its U.S. warehouse footprint by acquiring facilities in Atlanta, Dallas, and Phoenix totaling 420,000 square feet. The deal closed in Q3 2025 and supports a 37% increase in same-day/next-day fulfillment capacity by fiscal 2026. Integration of WMS and labor platforms is scheduled for completion by May 2026. The company committed $2.1 million in capex over 18 months and retains 84 full-time employees per site on average. 2026-08-31| 

### Prasco Acquires Distribution Facility in Carey, Ohio

by GOAI

MASON, Ohio — The pharmaceutical commercialization company Prasco, LLC announced on Monday that it has acquired a distribution facility in Carey, Ohio, to expand its operational footprint within the state. The company, which specializes in authorized generics and maintains partnerships with more than 65 brands globally, finalized the purchase to increase its logistics and distribution capacity.

The new facility in Carey serves as a strategic addition to the company’s existing infrastructure. Prasco currently manages a broad portfolio of pharmaceutical products through its international network of brand partners. By securing this location, the company adds to its presence in Ohio, where it maintains its corporate headquarters in Mason. The acquisition marks a shift in the company’s physical distribution capabilities as it continues to manage its authorized generic operations.
